extra_quotes: We develop the Flux Derivative Formalism (FDF), a kinetic framework that provides a systematic route from the Boltzmann equation to nonlocal constitutive equations.
For each periodic unit cell we solve Eqs. (23) and (24), imposing a temperature difference ∆T between two opposite terminals and the diffuse-wall conditions (25)–(26) at the pore surfaces.

The FDF approach is expected to remain accurate provided the neglected higher-order spatial and temporal variations remain comparatively small, i.e., when the transport length scales of interest are not much shorter than the electronic mean free path.
